{{dablink|For other uses of the word "spring," see [[Spring]].}}
'''Breen's Spring''' is a village on the [[Caemlyn Road]] in [[Andor]]. It is located between [[Four Kings]] and [[Carysford]]

According to [[Hyam Kinch]], Breen's Spring marks the westernmost point from [[Caemlyn]] where the [[Queen's Guards]] regularly patrol, although they will go further if needed.{{Ref/book|1|33}}

== History ==
[[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]] likely passed through Breen's Spring on their way to the capital, but it is unclear which village it was, and whether it was before or after they encountered a [[Darkfriend]] in [[Market Sheran]].
